name: Development
description: Hardware resource policy biased for sustained mixed workloads (coding, compilation, containers) without permanently forcing a performance governor. This is the resource-policy layer only: the S3 development toolchain (editors, language toolchains, container runtimes) is separate, unimplemented future work. See docs/hardware/architecture.md.

rollback.notes: No Apply mechanism exists yet in S2; serein hardware plan is read-only. See docs/hardware/architecture.md for what a future Apply step would need.
